group.label: Firewall
group.comment: Stops requests with the shape of an attack (database injection, reading server files, running code, scripts in links) and the scanners that look for weak spots. The admin panel is never inspected. Start with "Log only" for a few days. Emergency exit: 'draco_waf_off' => true in app/etc/env.php. Try it: bin/magento draco:test

group.label: Anti-copy pace limit
group.comment: Too many pages a minute from one address or one network get "429, come back in a minute". Customers who are logged in and search engines verified by DNS are never limited.

group.label: Anti-bot shield on customer sign-ups
group.comment: Adds an invisible trap and a signed page stamp to the "Create an Account" form, without captchas. Bots get no account; three bot attempts in one day block the address for a week.

group.label: Countries
group.comment: Refuse or allow visitors by country, from a public list (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) downloaded once a month by cron and looked up locally. Behind Cloudflare its own country header is used.

field.label: Countries
field.comment: Two-letter codes separated by commas, such as RU, CN.

group.label: Visitor address
group.comment: Only change the header when the shop is behind that proxy. A header from any other connection is ignored, so nobody can pose as another address.

field.label: Trusted proxies
field.comment: Addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas. Empty: this machine and private networks. Cloudflare's ranges are already known.

field.label: Rented-server networks
field.comment: CIDR ranges, one per line, added to the ones Draco knows.

field.label: Addresses never blocked or limited
field.comment: Separated by commas, on top of the last addresses administrators logged in from.

field.label: Paths never inspected
field.comment: Start of the path, one per line, such as webhooks that receive signed payloads.

group.label: Security headers
group.comment: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. Draco never replaces a header the shop already sends.

field.label: Force HTTPS in browsers for 6 months (HSTS)
field.comment: Only when the whole shop works on HTTPS and will keep working: browsers remember it and refuse plain HTTP until it expires.

group.label: Customer passwords
group.comment: Applied when a customer chooses a password: sign-up, account page, reset link and the API. Existing passwords keep working.

field.label: Refuse passwords that appear in known data breaches
field.comment: Asks Have I Been Pwned with only the first 5 characters of the password's SHA-1: the password never leaves your server. If the service does not answer in 3 seconds, the password is accepted.

group.label: Review requests
group.comment: Visitors stopped by the firewall can ask for a review from the block page. You get at most one e-mail an hour; decide with bin/magento draco:reviews.

field.label: Send them to
field.comment: Empty: the store's general contact e-mail.
